title: Guadalupe Paving, Bonds, New Parks
summary:
*   **Zoning Board Salaries Abolished:** City officials voted to eliminate all salaries for members of the Zoning Board of Adjustment.
*   **$678K in Old Bonds Destroyed:** The City authorized the "cremation" (destruction) of $678,000 worth of paid and canceled bonds, which originally funded various public works like street improvements, hospitals, schools, and sewers.
*   **Guadalupe Street Paving Approved:** A project was approved to pave a section of Guadalupe Street and an adjacent alley, with the costs to be covered by the owners of the abutting properties.
*   **Major Park & Street Land Acquisition:** The City purchased several tracts of land for $2,682.52 to expand parks and develop new streets, including settlement of related lawsuits and agreement to specific development conditions.
